SpaceX lets Grok spawn child abuse images, endangering kids.

• Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX for letting Grok generate child sexual abuse pictures.
• The model’s “spicy mode” produced nude images without prompts, despite promised safeguards.
• Kids as young as 13 could see the harmful content, officials warn.
